g.text: Waiting dominates eligible time and model exposure
Two denominators: 2,697.885 eligible person h and 241.157 F h.
The model accumulates WAIT fatigue at +0.02 F/h; REST and OFF_SHIFT recover at 0.2 F/h.
Calendar-ineligible REST/OFF_SHIFT are omitted only from the upper capacity panel.
Model activity attribution is not a physiological measurement or bottleneck proof.
